🔥🇲🇽 <u>VERACRUZ STRIPS IMMUNITY FROM MC MAYOR ACCUSED OF ORDERING JOURNALIST'S MURDER</u>

Veracruz's Congress voted 40-8 to remove immunity from Raúl González Martínez, the Movimiento Ciudadano mayor of Ixhuatlán del Sureste, accused as the intellectual author of the June 2 murder of journalist Roxana Berenice Guzmán Ramírez in Nanchital. He is the second MC mayor stripped of immunity in the state this week. MC calls it "political persecution" — while claiming zero tolerance for impunity.

🇲🇽⚖️ <u>MEXICAN NATIONAL PLEADS GUILTY IN US TO LAUNDERING $1.97M IN DRUG MONEY</u>

Daniel Gordiano Valenzuela, 60, pleaded guilty in the United States to conspiring to launder $1,973,076 in drug proceeds: cash collected in cities across the US, then moved to Mexico through cryptocurrency and bank transfers. He was residing in Mexico when arrested, according to the US Department of Justice.

🇲🇽🏠 <u>CDMX DELIVERS 3,500 HOUSING ACTIONS FOR 11,000 RESIDENTS</u>

Mexico City's government delivered more than 3,500 housing actions — home improvements and new construction through affordable credits — benefiting 11,000 residents, plus 434 property deeds with full legal certainty. The package includes 759 credits worth 186 million pesos and 265 eco-tech upgrades like solar panels and water-saving systems. Under Clara Brugada, housing in the capital is a right being delivered, not a promise.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>AYOTZINAPA CASE: EX-GUERRERO GOVERNOR ORDERED TO PRISON, HOUSE ARREST DENIED</u>

A judge imposed pretrial detention on Ángel Aguirre Rivero — Guerrero's governor when the 43 students disappeared — on forced disappearance charges, rejecting house arrest despite his age and health. The FGR says the ex-governor ordered the concealment of key evidence in the Ayotzinapa case, backed by telephone records. Almost 12 years later, the cover-up is on trial.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>"COORDINATION WITHOUT SUBORDINATION": SHEINBAUM SETS TERMS FOR US SOUTHERN COMMAND</u>

The US Southern Command just launched a joint force with 18 regional allies to fight "narcoterrorism" and migration. President Sheinbaum's answer: Mexico will coordinate where it corresponds — "coordination without subordination, defense of sovereignty and defense of our country's territoriality." Mexico has always worked with Northern Command, within its Constitution and laws. Washington can expand SouthCom's remit; Mexico's terms don't change.

🇲🇽🧪 Mexican lettuce cleared in US cyclospora outbreak — every test negative. "We took 5 whole lettuces before processing, 5 samples of chopped lettuce and water. All were negative. The hypothesis is not confirmed... the Mexican origin has not been proven." — Víctor Hugo Borja Aburto, Cofepris chief The FDA linked a US outbreak (6,358 cases, 15 states) to packer Taylor Farms in Guanajuato. Cofepris, Senasica and Epidemiology inspected the plant; all molecular tests came back negative. Mexico has 33 confirmed cases this year and no active outbreak.

🇲🇽🛢️ "The motivation is energy sovereignty." "The motivation is energy sovereignty." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, on non-conventional gas Sheinbaum defended exploring non-conventional gas in Mexico: renewables come first, but dependence on imported gas must be cut with domestic production.

🇲🇽🔍 Ayotzinapa: "All my energy and will for full justice." "It has nothing to do with politics, it is part of an investigation... I will put all my energy and will into achieving full justice in the Ayotzinapa case." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, on the Ayotzinapa case Former Guerrero governor Ángel Aguirre was detained in the Ayotzinapa investigation after months of FGR intelligence work, with testimony from the "verdad histórica" era and after. Sheinbaum will meet the families of the 43 students this month.
